feedback: Iteration 0 has no earlier race, so there is no outcome or telemetry to cite; these points rest on the design contract only. I did not have to compensate for any geometry behaviour in the controller yet, since this is the first integration. Decision rule for the next race: if the race ends with progress well short of 1 and max_error near the 0.06 m off-track limit, the array is losing the line on bends; widen the array or narrow sensor spacing to 0.015 to 0.02 m total, and keep sensor_size at 0.012 so the tape still covers about two sensors. If the robot completes but takes more than about 3 s, speed is limiting; increase wheel_radius toward 0.035 or base_speed is already at 1.4, so the geometry lever is wheel_radius. If steering_oscillation is high, reduce the sensor weights (for example to [-1,-0.5,0,0.5,1]) rather than adding derivative. If rms_error is low and the run completes, keep the geometry and try a narrower wheel_track of 0.10 to 0.11 m for sharper turning authority.
requested_changes: If the robot leaves the track or progress stalls on bends, widen the array to sensor x values of -0.03 to +0.03 m (or narrow spacing to 0.015 m total) and keep sensor_size at 0.012 m; no earlier evidence yet, so this is a conditional test.
If completion_time is above 3 s with the robot still on the line, raise wheel_radius to 0.035 m to increase ground speed per PWM; this is a conditional test with no earlier evidence.
If steering_oscillation is high after the first race, lower sensor weights to [-1,-0.5,0,0.5,1] rather than adding kd; this is a conditional test with no earlier evidence.
